The top D2C brands in India for 2026 list covers 100 Indian D2C brands across these fashion, home decor, accessories, health, beauty and food, with their founding year, headquarters, founders, and products. Also find a free checklist guide and a PDF with the list of AI prompts for starting your own D2C brand.

The top D2C brands in India include names such as boAt, Lenskart, Mamaearth, Wakefit, The Souled Store, SUGAR Cosmetics, BlueStone, and Country Delight, spanning categories from fashion and beauty to home, wellness, and food. This list covers 100 D2C brands in India and provides their founding year, headquarters, founders, and key products.

India’s direct-to-consumer channel currently accounts for $10–12 billion in e-commerce sales, according to [McKinsey’s February 2026 report](https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/logistics/our-insights/the-great-unbundling-of-indian-e-commerce-msmes-and-the-direct-to-consumer-revolution). The report projects this channel could reach $60 billion by 2030, with D2C adoption accelerating nearly three times faster than e-commerce marketplace growth.

The brands below show how Indian businesses are building direct relationships with customers across different product categories and business models. Use the list to discover established D2C brands, emerging companies, and ideas for building your own D2C brand.

#### Key Takeaways

- India’s D2C ecosystem now spans a wide range of consumer categories, with strong brands emerging in fashion, beauty, accessories, wellness, home, and food.
- Brands such as boAt, Lenskart, Mamaearth, and Wakefit have grown from consumer-focused startups into much larger businesses with expanding offline and omnichannel presence.
- Several Indian D2C brands have moved beyond the traditional online-first model, with some entering public markets and others building significant physical retail networks.
- Clothing and fashion continue to be major areas for D2C entrepreneurship, alongside fast-growing opportunities in beauty, personal care, wellness, and food.

## Top 30 Clothing D2C Companies In India

### **1\. 20Dresses**

Fashion startups dominate the D2C market since the country’s fashion business has the [most potential and is estimated to reach $43.2 billion](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1294150/india-online-fashion-market-size-in-d2c-sector/).

![Twenty dresses](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20343'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2012

**Headquarters location**: Mumbai

**Founder**: Sumant Kasliwal

**What do they sell**: Women’s clothing

Started by Sumant Kasliwal in 2012, 20Dresses is a brand spinning on trends, celebrating fashion, empowerment, and modern femininity through its designs. With over 150,000 subscribers, 20Dresses.com has established itself as the fastest-growing women’s fashion brand and one of India’s most popular D2C examples.

### **2\. Fully Filmy**

![Fully filmy D2C brand Qikink](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20875%20438'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2015

**Headquarters location**: Chennai

**Founder**: Raunaq Mangottil & Anand Srinivasan

**What do they sel** l: Clothing and accessories

The name says it all – Fully Filmy. Movie-obsessed founders Raunaq Mangottil and Anand Srinivasan started their brand in 2015 and are one of the top clothing brands in India, selling online and owning offline stores in some states.

Fully Filmy is all about movies from Bollywood, Kollywood, Tollywood, and Hollywood. You can shop by movies or their famous one-liners from a massive collection of products ranging from men’s and women’s clothing, accessories, and home decor.

### **3. Bombay Shirt Company**

![Bombay Shirt Company D2C brand](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20875%20438'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2012

**Headquarters location**: Chennai

**Founder**: Akshay Narvekar

**What do they sel** l: Shirts and pants

Bombay Shirt Company is an online apparel business founded in 2012 by Akshay Narvekar. The company provides customised clothing for both men and women. It now owns four brands: Bombay Shirt Company, Pause, and Korra. It has offices in India, Dubai, and New York.

Lightbox Venture Capital and private investors Amit and Arihant Patni are among its backers.

### **4\. Let’s Dress Up**

![Lets Dress Up](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20791%20473'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2019

**Headquarters location**: Gurgaon

**Founder**: Aditya Balani and Drishti Anand

**What do they sell**: Women’s Clothing

LetsDressUp, created by husband-wife Aditya Balani and Drishti Anand, is one of India’s leading D2C Brands. Its service provides custom-made designer clothing delivered right to your home. It provides a platform where people can acquire dresses tailored to their size and style.

The company has generated almost 10,000 distinct designs since its beginnings. You may even personalise the outfits with your favourite character. It is also known as the Stitch Fix of India.

### **5. Bewakoof**

![Bewakoof D2C brand India](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20875%20438'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2012

**Headquarters location**: Bangalore

**Founder**: Prabhkiran Singh and Siddharth Munit

**What do they sell**: Men’s and women’s clothing, accessories

Bewakoof is an online D2C fashion business that provides men’s and women’s mobile covers, clothes, and accessories. Bewakoof, founded in 2012 by Prabhkiran Singh and Siddharth Munit, has sold over 2 million goods with original and amusing designs!

The company’s odd yet accessible name has been widespread, particularly among those aged 16 to 34. Bewakoof used Justdial and Facebook to market their products in the beginning. Their page got 75,000+ users in just a few months. They also ran college ads promising free shirts from the brand.

Bewakoof’s operations give them a bird’s-eye perspective of everything, from design and merchandising to web marketing. They blend TV program punchlines and social media memes into their work to stay current. Furthermore, they invite suggestions from their 1.5 million social media followers.

### **6\. Snitch**

![Snitch D2C brand India](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20875%20438'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2018

**Headquarters location**: Bangalore

**Founder**: Siddharth D

**What do they sell**: Men’s clothing and accessories

Siddharth D founded Snitch in 2018. SNITCH creates apparel for the fashion-forward modern guy, drawing influence from worldwide. As a men’s fast fashion business with a unique style approach, the brand produces styles in reaction to the newest trends.

What sets them apart: Their goal is to be the fastest fast-fashion brand for guys. Most manufacturers focus on seasonal collections. However, the SNITCH team creates new daily trends that customers can wear throughout the year. They consider fashion to be something that happens every day.

### **7. Faballey**

![FabAlley](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20344'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2012

**Headquarters location**: Noida

**Founders**: Shivani Poddar and Tanvi Malik

**What do they sell**: Women’s clothing

According to Tofler, FabAlley declared a profit of INR 27.5 Cr in the fiscal year 2020-21, while its operating income was INR 105 Cr.

Shivani Poddar and Tanvi Malik started FabAlley in 2012 as a High Street Essentials brand. It distributes women’s western clothing through online marketplaces, physical retail locations, multi-brand outlets (MBOs), and its website.

### **8\. Wear Your Opinion**

![Wear Your Opinion (WYO.in) D2C brand India](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20875%20438'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2013

**Headquarters location**: Mumbai

**Founder**: Rajveen Khandelwal

**What do they sel** l: Clothing and accessories

Wear Your Opinion is a site and platform where you can get beautiful apparel that will help you express yourself better and help people express themselves. Each design represents something about personality qualities you can relate to or connect with.

When you buy from them, they will not be your vendor, but you and your buddy will have an unbreakable link with them.

### 9\. Redwolf

![Redwolf](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20258'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2011

**Headquarters location**: Mumbai

**Founder**: Ameya Thakur and Rahul Jaisheel

**What do they sell**: Clothing and accessories

Redwolf is an independent apparel business that curates beautiful artwork from artists worldwide and strives to manufacture the best T-shirts possible with every purchase.

They believe in excellent art and artists. The species and its mythology, Redwolf, run in pairs and strongly feel brotherhood and solidarity.

### **10\. Blissclub**

![Blissclub D2C brand India](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20875%20438'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2020

**Headquarters location**: Bangalore

**Founder**: Minu Margeret

**What do they sell**: Women’s clothing and accessories

BlissClub is a direct-to-consumer (D2C) business that provides women’s sportswear, including bottoms, sports bras, shirts, tees, and co-ords. BlissClub has its headquarters located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. BlissClub employs 120 people. BlissClub established the organisation in the year 2020 as a for-profit organisation.

### **11\. Creatures Of Habit**

![Creatures of Habit D2C brand India](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20875%20438'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

**Founded in**: 2018

**Headquarters location**: Noida

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### 1\. What does D2C brand mean?

A D2C (direct-to-consumer) brand sells its products directly to customers instead of relying entirely on traditional retail intermediaries. It typically uses its own website, app, physical stores, or other direct sales channels to reach customers and manage the buying experience.

#### 2\. What is a D2C brand in India?

A D2C brand in India sells products directly to Indian customers through channels such as its own website, app, or physical stores. Indian D2C brands operate across categories including fashion, beauty, wellness, home decor, accessories, and food, using direct channels to build relationships with their customers.

#### 3\. What should D2C Brands mainly Focus on?

With technological advancement and more brands launching every day, D2C brands need to focus on seven key areas to run a successful brand. They are:

• **Improved UI/UX:** The intersection of design and technology. Interfaces that are cleaner and load faster across devices.

• **Platform Upgrade:** More willingness to invest in enterprise-grade Magento and Shopify platforms.

• Improved Coordination of **Promotional Creatives** (Banners / Emailers / Push Notifications): More coordinated creative shot planning

• **Conversion Rate Optimisation** is a critical factor that many companies overlook.

• With **Fast commerce** spreading, firms will undoubtedly experiment with hyperlocal delivery in locations with storefronts.

• **Increasing Marketing Automation Spending:** Increased usage of solutions that can assist in tailoring the experience.

• **Analytics:** Increasingly, companies want to know how analytics can help them scale, but they need to figure out how to incorporate that power into their day-to-day operations.

#### 4\. What Challenges do D2C Brands face?

The challenges D2C firms experience during their early breakthrough phases can hamper e-commerce development, ranging from sales conversion to logistical delays. These are five obstacles that D2C business models face:

1) Inventory management

2) Customer retention

3) Cost of acquisition

4) Order fulfilment

5) Shipping delays

#### 5\. What is the Traditional Business Model?

The traditional business model involves companies interacting with customers and selling products through methods like advertising and physical stores. It’s been around for centuries, with variations like door-to-door sales, but the internet has sped up changes. Examples include direct sales, franchising, ads, and brick-and-mortar stores.

#### 6\. What are the Advantages of the D2C Business Model?

• **Controlled Customer Experience:** D2C brands manage every aspect of the customer journey, ensuring consistency and loyalty.

• **Higher Profits:** Cutting out middlemen leads to increased profit margins.

• **Rich Customer Insights:** Direct sales provide valuable data for product development and marketing.

• **Agility and Speed:** D2C brands can quickly adapt to trends and bring products to market faster.

• **Enhanced Brand Awareness:** Direct online sales reach wider audiences and allow for flexible branding and pricing.
